_note: PROVISIONAL. T-01 requires the golden vectors the web repo uses, byte for byte - do not maintain a second set. These eight were authored from RFC 8785 directly because the web repo was not available on this machine. Replace this whole file with the web repo's fixture and re-run; the test reads it and asserts nothing else.

vectors.name: utf16-key-ordering
vectors.why: RFC 8785 sorts by UTF-16 code units. The emoji's lead surrogate 0xD83D sorts BEFORE U+FB33, where a scalar-value sort puts it after.

input.ö: Latin Small Letter O With Diaeresis

vectors.name: ecmascript-numbers
vectors.why: Number output follows ECMAScript Number::toString, not printf.

vectors.name: nesting-and-whitespace
vectors.why: Members sort at every depth; array order is data and is preserved.

vectors.name: string-escapes
vectors.why: Only the mandated escapes, short forms where they exist, sub-0x20 as u00xx.

vectors.name: receipt-body
vectors.why: The shape this product actually hashes.

vectors.name: unicode-passthrough
vectors.why: Non-ASCII is emitted literally as UTF-8, never as escapes.

vectors.name: empty-containers-and-key
vectors.why: The empty key sorts first; empty containers survive.

vectors.name: literals
vectors.why: Booleans must not bridge through NSNumber into 0 and 1.
